turns.assessment: The outage is a common optical impairment on the S15→S05 direction, not a client or individual transponder failure: many unrelated services failed or protected simultaneously, while seven coherent receivers showed the same large DGD increase with BER degradation and OTU_LOF. Optical power, OSNR, amplifier telemetry, and the reverse direction remained unchanged, strongly identifying DGD_RISE in the fibre approaching S05. The aerial 78.3 km span E16 is the most likely stressed section.

proposals.rationale: E16 is the aerial span on S15→S05 immediately approaching S05. A large common DGD step, unchanged power/OSNR, and failures across multiple channels are the documented signature of fibre DGD rise; the unaffected reverse direction localizes it to this directional fibre.
Another span on the same S15→S05 optical path could produce the same receiver-side DGD signature, but it is less likely than the identified aerial section.
This intermediate S15→S05 span could also cause common accumulated DGD without a power change, though there is less evidence of mechanical or environmental susceptibility than for E16.
